scope: Baseline inventory for the eight reporting-foundations families selected in the US supplement. It records which existing source and question IDs are reused or deepened, which package artifacts are new, and which populations remain unresolved. It is a research-scope artifact, not a claim that the baseline or selected slice is complete.

shared_generator_dependency.remaining_scope: The generator's first-run construction-association preservation fix and clean-artifact regression remain owned by AA-I119. The current canonical construction records were restored for this branch's artifact, but that manual restoration is not final until the shared generator revision is integrated and rerun.

baseline.population: Existing named foundation guides, their retained IFRS and other framework questions, and the shared sources used to route the selected private nongovernmental US GAAP January 2026 fixture.

disposition_legend.reuse: Existing source identity is reused within its declared jurisdiction, framework, period and access boundary.
disposition_legend.deepen: Existing guide and named questions remain stable while the selected family receives an additional US-scoped question.
disposition_legend.new: A new bounded question or source record is added by this supplement; it is not evidence of family-wide sufficiency.
disposition_legend.unresolved: The population or authority remains outside the selected evidence slice and is explicitly routed for later work.

original_acceptance_evidence.requirement: Inventory existing records and questions with explicit roles, frameworks, periods and populations.
original_acceptance_evidence.result: Corrected by this durable inventory: 12 existing source IDs are classified for reuse, eight existing guides and 16 existing questions are classified for deepening, eight new questions and six new sources are listed, and unresolved populations are named.

original_acceptance_evidence.requirement: Add original US authority-linked answers with publisher URLs, locators, effective or access metadata and rights state.
original_acceptance_evidence.result: Bounded evidence is retained with original publisher URLs, locators, effective-period notes, review levels, source checks and unresolved rights. Four answers are explicitly evidence-gap research leads where current FASB text was not accessed.

original_acceptance_evidence.requirement: Supply inputs, accounting workflows, controls and worked material.
original_acceptance_evidence.result: The selected synthetic entity, January 2026 period, source-event register, six balanced proposed journals, explicit FX conversion, statement tie-out and review-only actions are directly represented and tested.

original_acceptance_evidence.requirement: Record canonical exceptions and professional or empirical limits.
original_acceptance_evidence.result: Nonprofit, SEC, state/local, federal, industry, live-close, current-authority and rights boundaries remain explicit. All eight new assessments are partial; professional review and empirical support are not established.

original_acceptance_evidence.requirement: Verify representative retrieval, scope counterexamples and same-build exports or checks.
original_acceptance_evidence.result: Retrieval, source pointers, IFRS preservation, fixture arithmetic, non-propagation, rights and export parity are tested locally. The canonical construction association cleanup remains dependent on AA-I119's shared generator preservation fix and clean-artifact regression. CI, deployment and final combined release selection remain separate gates.

limits: This inventory classifies the selected research slice and does not inventory every record in the full corpus.
A reuse disposition preserves a source identity or question context; it does not grant source rights or accounting authority.
A deepen disposition does not revise or replace the retained IFRS question and does not imply family-wide sufficiency.
The selected sector-54 assessment is a schema anchor only and does not establish Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services adequacy.
Construction source-association cleanup is not complete until AA-I119's generator revision is shared, integrated and rerun; the branch preserves the current clean artifact as an interim state only.
